mapper.sql: select tstockmain.id, tstockmain.material_id, tstockmain.library_count, tstockmain.available_count, tstockmain.create_by, tstockmain.create_time, tstockmain.update_by, tstockmain.update_time, tstockmain.remark, tstockmain.dept_id, tstockmain.dept_name, tstockmain.del_flag from t_stock_main tstockmain
mapper.select:
select a.id, a.material_id, a.library_count, a.available_count, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.remark, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, tm.code as materialCode, tm.name as materialName, tm.specifications, tu.name as unitName, tc.name as categoryName, tcu.name as contactsUnitName, tuc.max_unit_name as packUnitName from t_stock_main a left join t_material tm on a.material_id = tm.id left join t_unit tu on tm.unit_id = tu.id left join t_category tc on tm.category_id = tc.id left join t_contacts_unit tcu on tm.contacts_unit_id = tcu.id left join t_unit_config tuc on tuc.material_id = tm.id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = tstockmain.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
a.del_flag = '0' and a.material_id = #{materialId} and a.library_count = #{libraryCount} and a.available_count = #{availableCount} and tm.contacts_unit_id = #{contactsUnitId} and tm.name like concat('%',#{materialName},'%') and tm.code like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%')
${params.dataScope}
mapper.delete: update t_stock_main set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

mapper.select: select a.id, a.material_id , a.library_count , a.available_count , m.code as materialCode, m.name as materialName, m.specifications , m.stock_min , m.stock_max , m.description , tu.name as unitName, b.name as categoryName from t_stock_main a left join t_material m on a.material_id = m.id left join t_unit tu on m.unit_id = tu.id left join t_category b on m.category_id = b.id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.library_count < m.stock_min and m.code like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%') and m.name like concat('%',#{materialName},'%')

select m.name as materialName, sum(a.library_count) libraryCount from t_stock_main a left join t_material m on a.material_id = m.id where m.del_flag='0' and a.del_flag = '0' group by a.material_id order by libraryCount desc
